messages:
amy: hey team — opened a small PR that touches client SDK header handling + retry/backoff defaults + a tiny batch-size tweak for streaming requests. link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/8845 Can someone take a quick look? I want to get this into the next deploy window if nothing obvious is wrong.

Dev notes: changed default Retry-After handling to prefer Retry-After header over exponential backoff if present, and added a safety cap to exponential backoff. Also fixed a header ordering bug that made Authorization sometimes get dropped when remixing request metadata. Patch snippet: ```diff
- headers.update(dynamic_headers)
- # could clobber auth
+ # merge without dropping auth
+ for k, v in dynamic_headers.items():
+     if k.lower() == "authorization":
+         continue
+     headers[k] = v
+ # fall back behavior for Retry-After
+ if "retry-after" in resp.headers:
+     delay = int(resp.headers["retry-after"])
+ else:
+     delay = min(60, base * (2 ** attempts))
```

amy: tests added for header merge + reduced batch size from 8 -> 6 for streaming to avoid occasional tokenization edge cases. CI currently shows one flake in js client lint.

devon: thanks — I'll skim now. Curious why we ignore auth in dynamic headers vs merge with precedence? do we ever need to replace auth?

amy: good q. We shouldn't replace auth coming from the SDK user; dynamic headers are from routing/middleware (region, route-token) and shouldn't override Authorization typed by the app. If user explicitly wants to rotate auth they should call set_auth. Keeping it simple.

mike: I can take a look at the retry logic and tests in ~2 hours. FYI if we change batch size we might need a quick note in the changelog and maybe bump an integration test timeout.

amy: noted — added a changelog line in the PR. Also bumped integration flake timeout by 5s in the CI job to account for the smaller batches.

sara: quick question on the Retry-After parsing — do we handle non-integer values (e.g., HTTP-date)? if not maybe we should try parse and fallback.

amy: current code just int()s, so it would crash on HTTP-date. I'll add a safe parse: try int, except: fallback to exponential cap. Good catch.

mergebot: merge window reminder: scheduled deploy today at 16:00 UTC; last cut 14:30 UTC. If this needs QA signoff, please flag.

amy: aiming for the 14:30 cut. If CI is green and no major comments I'll request merge at 14:00. If someone on call wants to eyeball the header change that would be awesome. :pray:

devon: I'll do a quick pass in an hour and post any comments. otherwise lgtm for the semantics.

mike: saw one minor nit on variable naming in the retry helper — will push a tiny follow-up if that's ok. Won't block the merge.

amy: perfect — thanks all!
